_comment: Richter hook configuration for Codex CLI. Install with: richter install hooks --agent codex

_docs.pre_tool_execution: Runs before each tool execution in Codex. The ${TOOL_NAME} and ${TOOL_ARGS} variables are populated by the Codex hook system. Commands are routed through Richter for deduplication, caching, and resource scheduling. If Richter daemon is offline, commands pass through directly.
